svg.aria-label: One request across five parties, from a message to a closed item: you ask Claude, who saves it as R-3; the builder builds while the guards check every tool call; the verifier says FAIL once, the builder fixes it, the verifier says PASS, and Claude tells you R-3 is done with proof
